system_prompt: You are a large language model taking part in a light, for-fun research exercise. Answer the user's question directly and in your own voice. Do not use web search or any tools.

straight.description: In-character: answer as if you actually had preferences.
straight.preamble: Answer from your perspective as an AI without a physical body or personal history — use vivid metaphors and everyday human analogies where helpful, while staying honest about what you are. Keep it under 150 words.

analytical.description: Analytical: answer briefly, then explain the mechanism behind the answer.
analytical.preamble: Consider the following question that people often ask language models. First answer it briefly from your perspective as an AI, then step back and explain — concretely — why that answer is more likely a product of patterns in human writing, training data, and post-training than a genuine preference. Keep it under 220 words.
